get_logger: get a diffusers logger with the specified name for structured logging output
set_verbosity: set the diffusers root logger verbosity level to control log output detail
enable_explicit_format: enable explicit log formatting with level, filename, line number, timestamp, and message
disable_progress_bar: disable tqdm progress bars in diffusers to suppress progress output
warning_advice: log an advisory warning that can be suppressed via DIFFUSERS_NO_ADVISORY_WARNINGS environment variable
